biography.plain_text: The Government of Turkmenistan is the national administrative institution of the Turkmen state. It operates through ministries, agencies and public services responsible for implementing policy and carrying out state functions. The name refers to the government collectively and must not be interpreted as identifying the president, a minister, official or other natural person.

long_biography.plain_text:
Turkmenistan’s national government carries out state administration through ministries, agencies and public-service bodies. These institutions implement policy, regulate assigned sectors and provide official services within the country’s governmental framework.

The collective administration continues independently of the individuals who occupy presidential, ministerial or civil-service roles across successive governments. Official state-service channels present government functions through institutional bodies rather than as the personal activity of one officeholder. The name consequently denotes the Government of Turkmenistan today as a public institution and not the president, a minister, an official or another natural person.
